accounting.rationale: Defines the source term or scope relation and maps it to the listed source-registration requirement.
Global/local restriction and four admissions are split.
Exception admits a USE rename use-name.
Exception admits common block homonym handling.
Exception admits an external procedure name that is also generic.
Exception admits the defining external function subprogram.
Same-class uniqueness, generic exceptions, and cross-class permission are split.
Different local identifier classes may share a spelling.
The SIN example illustrates local identifier shadowing of an intrinsic; the normative rule is p3 and the procedure/intrinsic catalogues.
General reuse permission and limited procedure-name uses are split.
Same spelling may identify another entity in another scope outside the listed exceptions.

review_rationale: Source registration for the Clause 19 heading, 19.1, 19.2, 19.3, 19.3.1-19.3.5 and 19.4: scopes, global and local identifiers, and statement and construct entities (batch251). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across four rounds; construct and statement entities are observed through outer sentinels and exact kinds, with the distinct-kind cases capability-selected. Source accounting only.
